notes.title: Power Champions Patch Update 1.2.5.5
notes.notes:
Welcome to Patch 1.2.5.5!

We're excited to announce some major updates to Power Champions. First and foremost, we've reduced the overall price from $4.99 to $2.99!

Here's what you can expect in this update:


 Quality of life improvements in the interface, with a wider variety of colors and designs for easier and more practical gameplay.
 Bug fixes in the World map and dialogue.
 Spelling corrections in various scenes.
 Changes to default settings, such as cell shading and outlines.
 Added item descriptions in the character selection screen.
 Introduction of an item that boosts damage, defense, and speed at the normal level, but becomes disabled after defeating the boss (both in the farming and boss maps).
 Text dialogue additions to certain NPCs to enhance immersion.
 Incorporation of new sounds, like character footsteps, and various sound improvements.
 Adjustment of character running animations to match assigned speed.


We hope you enjoy these enhancements and continue to have a fantastic experience in Power Champions!
